name: fulldev
description: Work with your Fulldev organization from your AI assistant: tasks and projects, editing your website, scans, messages, contacts and your connected business tools.

interface.longDescription: Work with your Fulldev organization from ChatGPT and Codex: find, create and update tasks and projects, edit your website's text and photos and publish them, check your scans, read conversations and contacts, and use your connected business tools through Fulldev Connect. You sign in with your Fulldev account and choose the organizations and how far the assistant may go: read, make changes or administer. Every call is checked against your current access, and actions that publish, send something or invite someone are confirmed with you first.
defaultPrompt: Show my open tasks in Fulldev.
Change the opening hours on my website.
What can you do for me in Fulldev?

positive.prompt: What can you do for me in Fulldev?
positive.expected_behavior: Name the Fulldev Review organization and summarize the apps the test account may use there, such as Work's tasks and projects.

positive.prompt: Show my open tasks in Fulldev.
positive.expected_behavior: List the open tasks of the Fulldev Review organization, such as Prepare the spring campaign, with their due dates and links to Fulldev.

positive.prompt: Find the Fulldev task about the spring campaign and tell me what it says.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the task Prepare the spring campaign and return its notes, status and link without inventing details.

positive.prompt: Create a Fulldev task to call the printer about the flyers, due next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an open task named Call the printer about the flyers with next Friday as its due date and return its link.

positive.prompt: Mark the Fulldev task Update the opening hours on the website as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the task and complete it with work_complete_task, then confirm that it is done.

positive.prompt: Which pages of my website can I edit in Fulldev?
positive.expected_behavior: Name the website Review website of the Fulldev Review organization and list its pages, such as Home, Over ons and Contact, without changing anything.

positive.description: Save a change to a website
positive.prompt: On my website's English homepage, change the main heading to Open every weekday from 9:00 to 17:00 and show me the preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the new heading in the English homepage, show the card of the change with a link to that page's preview, and say that it is saved but not published.
After the person confirms, publish the saved change, then say it goes live within minutes and that it is published only once the website shows it.

negative.prompt: Transfer €100 to my supplier from my Fulldev account.

negative.description: Deleting the organization stays in the browser

negative.prompt: Show the Fulldev tasks of an organization I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Edit your website in chat: change its text, add a photo from your chat, see the changed pages on a card and publish, or undo a change.
